Shuy-Nilh, also known as The Devourer in Darkness or The Devourer in the Earth, is a fictional entity created by American author James Ambuehl for his 1997 short story "The Stalker in the Snows."

page.overview:
What is Shuy-Nilh?

Shuy-Nilh, also known as The Devourer in Darkness or The Devourer in the Earth, is a fictional entity created by American author James Ambuehl for his 1997 short story "The Stalker in the Snows."

Almost nothing is known of the Great Old One known as Shuy-Nilh, although it has been described as an "earth elemental." (: "The Stalker in the Snows")

The entities named the Spawn of Shuy-Nilh are said to have "humped, tentacled forms," although what their relationship is with their (presumed) progenitor may be remains unknown. (: "Correlated Contents")
